extracted.intended_audience: owners/operators of stationary sources, environmental compliance managers, and State agencies implementing NSPS (EPA regulated facilities)
extracted.subtask_description: Table-of-contents style index of 40 CFR Part 60 subparts and sections describing applicability, standards (VOC, PM, SO2, etc.), testing, monitoring, reporting, recordkeeping, preconstruction and state-plan requirements for new and modified stationary sources. Used by facility operators and regulators for compliance planning and implementation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicability and designation of affected facility
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections titled 'Applicability and designation of affected facility' or similar (e.g., 'Am I subject to this subpart?') that define which facilities/sources/subcategories the subpart applies to and how an affected facility is designated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Determines scope of coverage for each subpart (who must comply). Appears repeatedly across subparts and includes delegation language in some subparts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections titled 'Definitions' or 'What definitions must I know?' that provide defined terms used throughout each subpart.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establishes precise meanings for terms used in standards, monitoring, reporting, reconstruction, etc.; essential for interpreting requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards for volatile organic compounds (VOCs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Subpart headings such as 'Standard for volatile organic compounds' or 'Standards for volatile organic compounds' setting emission limits and/or control requirements for VOC emissions for particular industries/processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies pollutant-specific limits and compliance expectations for VOCs; often paired with performance testing and monitoring provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards for particulate matter (PM)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections labeled 'Standards for particulate matter' or similar that set emission limits and applicable requirements for particulate matter emissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes stack emission limits, fugitive emission limits, and may reference testing or capture-system tables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards for sulfur dioxide (SO2)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections explicitly setting standards for SO2 emissions (e.g., 'Standards for sulfur dioxide').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes compliance provisions specific to SO2 and may include monitoring/test method references.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards (generic / process-specific)
rubrics_metrics.description: Generic 'Standards' or numbered 'Standards' headings (e.g., 'Standards: General', 'Standards: Process emissions') that set the substantive emission or equipment performance requirements for the subpart or process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May be subdivided by equipment types or process units; establishes baseline performance obligations operators must meet.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standards for equipment components (pumps, compressors, valves, connectors, pressure relief devices, sampling connections, open-ended lines)
rubrics_metrics.description: Many subparts include granular standards for specific equipment categories: pumps in light/heavy liquid service, compressors, valves in gas/vapor or light liquid service, connectors, pressure relief devices, sampling connection systems, open-ended valves/lines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies allowable leak criteria, maintenance/repair timelines, allowable percent leaking, and service-specific criteria; often tied to monitoring and leak detection and repair (LDAR) programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternative standards for valves—allowable percentage of valves leaking
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternate compliance pathway setting an allowable percentage of leaking valves as the standard.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides an alternative numeric threshold instead of 100% non-leaking expectation; used where aggregate percent-based approach is permitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alternative standards for valves—skip period leak detection and repair
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternate standards that allow skip periods in leak detection and repair schedules under defined conditions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies conditions and timing under which valve inspection intervals may be extended or skipped.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equivalence/permission to use alternative means of emission limitation
rubrics_metrics.description: Provisions titled 'Equivalence of means of emission limitation' or 'Permission to use alternative means of emission limitation' allowing use of other controls or methods determined equivalent to the prescriptive standard.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes criteria and approval process for demonstrating equivalence of alternate control strategies or equipment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Performance test and compliance provisions / Test methods and procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections establishing required performance tests, test methods, procedures, and compliance provisions to demonstrate that equipment/processes meet standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers which test methods to use, frequency/schedule of testing, how test data are applied to determine compliance, and reference to appendices/standard methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitoring of emissions and operations / Monitoring requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Provisions requiring monitoring of emissions and operational parameters, including installation, operation, maintenance, and data collection for monitoring systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes continuous emission monitoring systems (CEMS), continuous opacity monitoring systems (COMS), continuous parameter monitoring systems (CPMS), discrete monitoring, and other monitoring device requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Continuous Emission Monitoring (CEMS) requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed CEMS requirements: what types must be performed/installed, how data are used, evaluation schedules, exemptions from appendices, minimum monitoring data, conversions/averaging, and actions when CEMS are unavailable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies validation, calibration, minimum data capture, averaging time conversions, recordkeeping and reporting of CEMS data, and allowable exemptions or substitutes (e.g., monitor CO2 instead of O2 in some cases).

rubrics_metrics.name: Continuous opacity monitoring system (COMS) requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: What is required for COMS: operation, data use, and performance requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers data application for opacity compliance and associated quality assurance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Continuous Parameter Monitoring System (CPMS) calibration and quality control
rubrics_metrics.description: Table and sections specifying calibration and quality control requirements for CPMS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes calibration frequency, QC procedures, and documentation required to validate CPMS data for compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operating parameters, operating parameter limits, and data monitoring/recordkeeping/compliance frequencies
rubrics_metrics.description: Tables and sections that list required operating parameters, their limits, and the frequency at which data must be monitored, recorded, and used for compliance determinations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operators must monitor and record specific process/operating parameters and adhere to specified limits and frequencies; used as alternative compliance demonstrations in some subparts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Calibration and quality control requirements for monitoring systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific calibration and quality control requirements for continuous or parameter monitoring systems (e.g., Table 4 CPMS QC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details acceptable calibration methods, frequency, reference standards, and documentation needed for QA/QC.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitoring of operations (other monitoring requirements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Miscellaneous monitoring requirements such as monitoring unit load, flue gas temperature at inlet to particulate control device, injection rate of activated carbon, and minimum data collection for CPMS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational parameter monitoring that supports emission control effectiveness and compliance determinations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stack testing requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for conducting stack tests: types of stack tests, test schedules, test methods, how stack test data are used, allowance for less frequent testing or deviations for unforeseen circumstances.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies required methods (referenced test methods), frequency (e.g., 13-month schedule), reporting and how tests are applied to compliance evaluations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recordkeeping requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections titled 'Recordkeeping requirements' and specific subsections about what records to keep (general, materials separation plan, siting analysis, operator training and certification, stack tests, continuously monitored pollutants/parameters, activated carbon usage), where to keep them, and retention periods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the content of records, physical/online storage location, retention durations, and record formats; often paired with reporting obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed reporting obligations: pre-construction reports, notices of construction, initial reports, annual reports, semiannual out-of-compliance reports, appropriate units of measurement, and when reports must be submitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies report content, timing/deadlines, acceptable measurement units, and procedures for notifying regulators of noncompliance or achieving increments of progress.

rubrics_metrics.name: What must I include in my notice of construction / initial report / annual report
rubrics_metrics.description: Subsections that list the required contents for notices of construction, initial reports, annual reports and other formal submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detailed lists of documents, data, and statements that must accompany specific filings; guidance on formats and supporting information.

rubrics_metrics.name: What to do if out of compliance / semiannual out-of-compliance reports
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and content requirements for reporting instances of noncompliance and submitting required corrective or explanatory information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies timelines for notification, remediation steps, and what must be included in out-of-compliance communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reconstruction—definitions and requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections defining reconstruction and the consequences/requirements if a source is reconstructed (e.g., applicability of standards, timing).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how reconstruction affects applicability and which provisions or new-source requirements apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delegation of authority / Who implements and enforces this subpart
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections addressing delegation of enforcement authority to States and which agency implements and enforces the subpart.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains State plan approval, delegation procedures, and circumstances where EPA retains authority.

rubrics_metrics.name: List of chemicals produced by affected facilities / chemicals affected by subpart
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections or tables listing chemicals that, if produced, make a facility subject to the subpart (e.g., 'list of chemicals produced by affected facilities'; 'chemicals affected by subpart').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to determine applicability for chemical-manufacturing-related subparts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equivalent equipment and procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Provisions allowing 'equivalent equipment and procedures' to be used in lieu of prescriptive equipment or methods when equivalence is demonstrated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines criteria and approval mechanism for accepting substitutes that achieve equivalent emissions limitations or performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exceptions and exemptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections titled 'Exceptions', 'Is this subpart exempt?', or similar that list exceptions to standards or exemptions from specific requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies circumstances under which particular requirements do not apply or special-case handling is allowed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Optional procedures for specific measurements (e.g., Tutwiler Procedure for H2S)
rubrics_metrics.description: Optional measurement procedures referenced for specific pollutants or parameters (example: 'Optional procedure for measuring hydrogen sulfide in acid gas—Tutwiler Procedure').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides alternative validated methods for measuring specific analytes when appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operating practice requirements / Good Combustion Practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Operating practice requirements including good combustion practices addressing operator training, certification, plant-specific training, operating manuals, and daily operating requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies who must be trained/certified, required content of plant-specific training and operating manuals, where manuals must be kept, and operational controls to assure good combustion and minimize emissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operator training requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections specifying what types of training must be done, who must complete operator training and by when, and what plant-specific training includes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets deadlines for training completion and describes curriculum/content expectations for operator courses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operator certification requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for certification of chief facility operator and shift supervisors, who may operate after certification, and procedures for temporary absence of certified operators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establishes certification types, required timelines, and contingency rules for operation during certified staff absence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operating requirements during startup, shutdown, and malfunction
rubrics_metrics.description: How operating requirements and emission limits apply or are adjusted during periods of startup, shutdown, and malfunction (SSM).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies treatment of SSM periods for compliance determinations and reporting requirements during such events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emission limits—regulated pollutants and numeric limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections listing regulated pollutants for a subpart and the numeric emission limits that must be met, including special treatment during SSM periods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May be presented in tables; establishes the pollutant-by-pollutant limits and compliance dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitoring, installation, operation, and maintenance requirements for closed vent systems and control devices
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for closed vent systems, control devices, and their monitoring to achieve emission control objectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers design, operation, monitoring, and maintenance obligations to ensure control devices meet performance expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements if using a flare to comply
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific provisions describing requirements and obligations when a flare is used as a compliance measure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Outlines operational parameters, monitoring, and recordkeeping specific to flares used for compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for closed vent systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific obligations for closed vent systems as a compliance option, including monitoring, design, and operational criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May reference equivalence approvals, monitoring frequency, and inspection/repair timelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tables of emission limits, monitoring requirements, operating parameters, CPMS QC, CEMS validation, and stack test requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple numbered tables referenced for each subpart (e.g., 'Table 1 Emission Limits', 'Table 2 Monitoring Requirements for 98 Weight-Percent Reduction or 20 ppmv', 'Table 3 Operating Parameters', 'Table 4 CPMS Calibration and QC', 'Requirements for validating CEMS', 'Requirements for Stack Tests').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tables provide the numeric limits, thresholds, monitoring frequencies, validation requirements, and test method specifications necessary for compliance; operators must follow table entries applicable to their source.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preconstruction requirements—Materials Separation Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Preconstruction obligations requiring submission of a materials separation plan: who must submit, what it is, steps, content of the draft plan, public availability, comment periods, public meetings, handling comments, revised plan actions, and submission of final plan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes a process that includes public notice, comment periods, and required content for materials separation plans prior to construction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preconstruction requirements—Siting Analysis
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for siting analyses before construction: who must submit, what a siting analysis is, required steps/content, public availability, comment periods, public meetings, handling comments, and submission process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Siting analysis includes public engagement and documentation demonstrating consideration of site selection impacts as part of preconstruction approvals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Model rule—Use of model rule and principal components
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections describing what the 'model rule' is for State plans, how it relates to required State plan elements, and the principal components of the model rule.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guides States on adopting consistent elements including increments of progress, emission limits, monitoring, recordkeeping, reporting, and other model provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Model rule—Increments of progress (compliance schedule)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for meeting increments of progress and achieving final compliance including deadlines, notifications of achievement, submission timing, and remedies if increments are not met.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies the sequential steps (control plan submittal, awarding contracts, initiating/completing construction) and required notifications and consequences for missed increments; includes handling for closures and restarts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Model rule—State plan submission, approval, and negative declarations
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for State plan requirements: what must be included, whether a State plan is required, approval process for State plan or negative declaration letter, and what if a plan is not approvable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains State responsibilities, federal review/approval mechanisms, and corrective actions when plans are insufficient.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emission Guidelines and compliance times for existing units
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections providing emission guidelines and compliance times for small municipal waste combustion units built on or before a specified date, tailored for State plans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: States must include schedules and requirements for existing sources to come into compliance under State plans adopting the model rule or equivalent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Air curtain incinerators—definitions, emission limits, opacity monitoring, recordkeeping/reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific provisions for air curtain incinerators burning 100% yard waste: definition, yard waste definition, emission limits, opacity monitoring requirements, and recordkeeping/reporting obligations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tailored operational and monitoring requirements for this narrow source category.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equations—what equations must I use?
rubrics_metrics.description: Provision referencing which equations (calculations/formulae) must be used to compute emissions, averages, conversions, or limits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the mathematical methods required for converting raw monitoring data into reported units and compliance metrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specifications for active collection systems and stack emission limits for capture systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Tables and sections specifying technical requirements for active collection systems and stack emission limits for facilities using capture systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines capture efficiencies, design specs, and emission thresholds applicable when capture systems are employed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fugitive emission limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Table/section setting fugitive emission thresholds for affected facilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies limits and potential monitoring/inspection obligations for fugitive emissions not captured by stack sampling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Delegation, exceptions, and delegation of authority
rubrics_metrics.description: Provisions on delegation of authority, delegation to State agencies, and specific exceptions to applicability or enforcement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains the administrative/implementation structure and any reserved authority for EPA versus delegated State implementation.
